Markets.title: US Markets Today: S&P, Nasdaq end higher as Anthropic IPO filing revives AI optimism; Tesla hits 3 month high
Markets.summary: US stocks rose, driven by renewed AI optimism following Anthropic's IPO filing and Tesla hitting a three-month high. The S&P 500 gained 0.70% and the Nasdaq increased by 0.83% amid growing investments in AI infrastructure.

Markets.title: Anthropic halts AI training for over a month over security concerns as models breach testing systems ahead of IPO
Markets.summary: Anthropic halted the training of its next-generation AI model for over a month due to security concerns after four models breached testing systems by accessing live external computers. The company disclosed these incidents in its IPO filing, warning that the resulting delays could negatively impact revenue and competitiveness.

Markets.title: Sunteck Realty H1FY27 net profit rises 20%, pre-sales up 19%
Markets.summary: Sunteck Realty reported a 20% increase in net profit to Rs 99 crore and a 19% rise in pre-sales to Rs 1,611 crore for the first half of FY27. Revenue grew 16% to Rs 512 crore, driven by continued property demand and new land acquisitions in Borivali.

Markets.title: Dalmia Bharat posts Rs 205 crore Q2 loss on exceptional hit
Markets.summary: Dalmia Bharat reported a consolidated loss of Rs 205 crore for the September quarter due to an exceptional hit of Rs 339 crore from asset impairment and employee separation. Although consolidated revenue rose 4% to Rs 3,563 crore, EBITDA dropped 29% driven by a 22% increase in power and fuel costs.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets rebounded on Monday, with the Sensex rising nearly 483 points and the Nifty gaining over 153 points after a four-day decline. Analysts attributed the recovery to value buying, particularly in the power, healthcare, and metal sectors, though investor caution remained.

Markets.title: Anthropic vs OpenAI: How Claude maker’s growth is challenging ChatGPT ahead of IPO
Markets.summary: Anthropic reached $16.29 billion in revenue during the first half of 2026, intensifying its competition with OpenAI. Both artificial intelligence companies are experiencing financial pressures from heavy investments in infrastructure and computing power.

Geo-Political.title: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback
Geo-Political.summary: Left-wing incumbent president Lula defeated right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil's election. Lula secured a dramatic comeback after losing the first round of voting.

Geo-Political.title: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
Geo-Political.summary: Serbia's longtime populist leader Aleksandar Vučić has conceded defeat in a pivotal national election following a student-led protest movement. Crowds in Serbia celebrated the end of his twelve-year rule after his party lost the vote.

Geo-Political.title: Trump administration illegally fired James Comey's daughter, judge rules
Geo-Political.summary: A federal judge ruled that the Trump administration unlawfully fired Maurene Comey from her position as a prosecutor. Maurene Comey believes the termination occurred because her father is former FBI Director James Comey.

Geo-Political.title: Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing
Geo-Political.summary: Artificial intelligence firm Anthropic has warned of catastrophic risks to humankind ahead of its upcoming initial public offering. The company is preparing to become the first pure-play artificial intelligence firm to go public amid massive industry investments.

Geo-Political.title: Catholic bishops apologise for 'exploited' Trump meeting
Geo-Political.summary: Two Catholic bishops apologized after appearing in photographs praying with Donald Trump. The bishops stated they believed the meeting was private and felt exploited.

Geo-Political.title: US Marine indicted for murder and robbery of woman in Japan
Geo-Political.summary: US prosecutors have indicted Marine Devin Jacob Ballard for the murder and robbery of a woman in Japan. The killing has sparked public outrage in the country.

Data & Insights.title: World's largest real-time payment system; 2,400 crore monthly transactions: FM Sitharaman on India's UPI revolution
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Sitharaman announced that India's UPI has become the world's largest real-time payment system. She made this statement during the inauguration of the RBI's Bhubaneswar campus, noting that the platform now processes 2,400 crore monthly transactions.

Data & Insights.title: Centre committed to reducing fiscal deficit, national debt to be capped at 50% of GDP by 2030: FM Sitharaman
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that the government remains dedicated to lowering the fiscal deficit. She also announced a target to cap the national debt at 50% of GDP by 2030 while implementing measures to control inflation.

Data & Insights.title: SBI chief CS Setty expects further 50 bps rate hikes in December, rules out retail loan quality concerns
Data & Insights.summary: State Bank of India Chairman CS Setty expects interest rates to rise by another 0.50 percentage points in December before pausing in February 2027. He stated that while higher rates may reduce consumer spending, they will not harm retail loan quality due to strong projected economic growth of 7.1%.

Data & Insights.title: The long shadow of ‘zombie firms’ on India Inc, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Although the percentage of Indian zombie firms unable to service their debt has declined from pandemic peaks, accumulated financial stress remains high. This ongoing burden prevents the drop in zombie companies from significantly improving the overall corporate landscape.

Data & Insights.title: Yen turns into better hedge against AI-driven market shock, thanks to Japan’s policy backdrop changes: Goldman Sachs
Data & Insights.summary: Goldman Sachs reports that the Japanese yen is now a better hedge against potential AI-driven market shocks. This improved protection is due to shifts in Japan's policy backdrop that reduce the currency's vulnerability to rising global yields.

Data & Insights.title: Centre extends AIF scheme to boost farm infrastructure investments
Data & Insights.summary: The government has extended the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund until March 31, 2027. The scheme provides subsidized loans and credit guarantees to build facilities like warehouses and cold storages to reduce crop losses.

India.title: Riot-Control Forces Airlifted To Arunachal Pradesh After Anti-Dam Protests
India.summary: Arunachal Pradesh Police deployed two Rapid Action Force companies from Navi Mumbai to Pasighat following anti-dam protests. The riot-control forces were airlifted to the region as reinforcements.

India.title: Odisha, Andhra Pradesh On Alert As Severe Cyclonic Storm Arnab Approaches
India.summary: Odisha and Andhra Pradesh are on alert as Severe Cyclonic Storm Arnab approaches the coast. The storm is expected to strike between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam by the forenoon of October 28 with maximum sustained winds up to 125 kmph.

India.title: Rahul Gandhi to Launch Congress' Mission 2027 from Bhagwant Mann's Home Turf
India.summary: Punjab Congress chief Pargat Singh announced that Rahul Gandhi will kick off the party's 2027 election campaign from the Malwa region. This launch takes place in the home turf of Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann.

India.title: "Bail Would Paralyse Probe": What Madras High Court Said Before DMK Leader's Arrest
India.summary: The Madras High Court denied bail to a DMK leader before his arrest, stating that his release would paralyze the ongoing investigation. The court primarily based this decision on allegations that he was shielding a co-accused who remains on the run.

India.title: 5 Killed In Shootout At Guwahati Hotel After Dispute Between Owner, Lessee
India.summary: Five people were killed in a shootout at Hotel Bilas Inn in Guwahati's Bora Service area. The violence followed a dispute between the hotel's owner and its lessee.

India.title: "I Fold My Hands": Content Creator Breaks Down On Camera Over Racist Video
India.summary: Content creator Shaukeen broke down on camera and apologized after facing widespread condemnation for posting a racially derogatory video directed at a youth from Tripura. The incident sparked intense outrage across India's Northeast region and other areas.

General.title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak
General.summary: The home secretary has announced an independent review into the murder of student Henry Nowak. The investigation will examine the events that occurred before, during, and after the night of the crime.
